rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Residential rental property owners may not use algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rents. Software providers and other coordinators may not use such software to facilitate agreements or coordinate pricing among competing landlords. The attorney general must set up a complaint portal.
rules.penalty: Existing remedies under the New Jersey Antitrust Act are preserved; no specific penalty stated.
rules.status_basis: The FAIR Act takes effect on July 1, 2027.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property owners and software providers or coordinators using algorithmic rent-setting tools.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Does not prohibit spreadsheets requiring human analysis, publicly available rent estimation tools, traditional real estate listing databases, or government-administered affordable housing programs.

rules.quoted_span: The FAIR Act prohibits residential rental property owners from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices.
